$comment: Consolidated register of documentary contradictions. Each entry names the values in conflict, the registered source of each value and where it sits, and what would resolve it. A contradiction stays here, with status open, until it is resolved; a resolved entry keeps its values and states the resolution. Validated by scripts/validate_registers.py.

same thread: computed by the thread author from other dimensions

values.location: same thread: later reply

values.location: plate 50-03, value MNL-964BC-0034 in catalog/measurements/MEAS-MANUAL-964-BODY-CONTROL.json

entries.next_step: The thread gives three incompatible values without a common datum, so it cannot confirm the 964 dimension R nor show that the 993 shares it. Decide only from an authorized 993 body-dimension document (see docs/research/993-body-dimensions-rights-note.md). On 2026-10-15 the claim was moved from validation.checks_passed to validation.known_limits in the 964 floor twin, and a correction note was added to the 964 data-gap research note.

entries.subject: Floor-assembly check dimensions: the 993 table transcribed in the Phase 1 inventory against the 964 volume V table

values.value: B/P3 = 670 +/- 0.5 mm; point labels A/P21, E/P18, F/P19, H/P20, L/P22 = 640 +/- 1 mm
values.location: floor-system table transcribed in docs/PHASE1_SOURCE_INVENTORY.md, section 'Batch 1 findings', from a third-party copy of the booklet (printed page 110 onward)

values.value: B = 610 +/- 1 mm between points 3 and 3; A on P20, E on P17, F on P18, H on P19, I on P21 = 640 +/- 1 mm
values.location: plate 50-03, values MNL-964BC-0019 to MNL-964BC-0027

entries.next_step: A, C, D, E, F, G and H carry the same numbers in both tables, B differs by 60 mm with a different tolerance, and the point numbering is shifted by one for A, E, F, H and the 640 mm dimension. This can be a real 964/993 difference (the 993 rear axle is new) or a transcription error; neither is established. Until an authorized copy of the 993 booklet or of 993 volume V is checked, no 964 value is used as a 993 value and the Phase 1 transcription is not 993 geometry.

entries.subject: The same third-party copy of the Porsche 'Technical Specifications 911 Carrera / Carrera 4 / Carrera RS, 94 and 95 Model' booklet is both rejected and registered as an available official source

values.value: rejected: hosting and reproduction rights not established, no PDF kept
values.location: docs/PHASE1_SOURCE_INVENTORY.md, table 'Rejected sources', row 'GitHub mirror of the booklet'

values.value: registered: source_type official, access available by direct_download, evidence level B
values.location: catalog/sources/src-porsche-993-spec-booklet-pubstack.json (digest-pinned by catalog/reference/993-turbo-research-20261002/manifest.json)

entries.next_step: Identity checked on 2026-10-15 from the copy's metadata and three page images only: 68 PDF pages, cover '94 Model 95 Model Technical Specifications', printed page 110 titled 'Dimensions for Floor System', last printed page 113. It is the document the Phase 1 inventory rejected. The record also omits the Carrera 4 and the body content from its coverage. The record is digest-pinned and cannot be edited in place. Owner decision: keep the record as a reference for factual values with the same undocumented-copy caveat as the workshop manuals, or supersede it with a record that marks the copy as rejected. The same archive also hosts four files named as 993 workshop repair manual volumes I to IV, which are not used.

entries.subject: Engine cooling-fan airflow

values.location: known_conflicts of the M64 BOM: 'Cooling airflow: 1010 l/s @ ~6100 rpm (primary, OBD supplement)'. That attribution was withdrawn on 2026-10-02 in docs/research/993-turbo-20261002/exports/fr/audit_contradictions.csv: row 'Source Engine Specifications' (the PDF linked by SRC-PORSCHE-993-OBD-SUPPLEMENT-ENGINE-SPECIFICATIONS-1996 is a hydraulic-lifter bulletin containing neither the 1010 l/s airflow nor the fan ratio) and row 'Données Carrera étendues à Turbo' (the 1010 l/s airflow is Carrera data, not to be applied to the Turbo). The record SRC-PORSCHE-993-ENGINE-SPECIFICATIONS-PUBSTACK states no airflow figure. The registered-source occurrence found in the catalogue is the workshop-manual OCR value MNL-OCR-0011 (PDF page 17, ocr_unreviewed), whose OCR text reads '1010 | / sec at 6,000 rpm of crankshaft'.
German technical-data compilation

entries.next_step: The two values may describe different engines (Carrera and Turbo); the Turbo brochure states a higher fan output without an absolute figure. No Turbo airflow is accepted from Carrera data.

entries.next_step: Row-level findings and actions stay in the audit files, which are digest-pinned; they are not duplicated here. Rows still unresolved there include the short piston spray-jet length (bulletin 21.5 mm against PET 22.5 mm, see SRC-PORSCHE-993-PISTON-SPRAY-JETS-1-97) and the engine-mount bolt thread pitch (see SRC-PORSCHE-993-TURBO-REAR-MOUNTS-1-99).
